summary: /music play now expands a YouTube playlist link (a /playlist?list=... URL) into every track it contains, capped at 50, enqueuing them all in order.
details: Only an explicit playlist-page link expands. An ordinary video link never does, even one carrying an incidental list=/index= param from being shared out of a playlist or an autoplay Mix -- those params are stripped so it always resolves to just that one video. Pasting a video link never silently queues fifty unrelated tracks.
TrackSource.resolve now returns a sequence of tracks instead of at most one; the reply reports "+N more from the playlist" when more than one was queued.
limitations: The 50-track cap is fixed, not configurable.
SoundCloud playlists are out of scope, same as SoundCloud itself (design/discord-music/01-playback-and-source.md).
